candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to read from a different immutable arg offset (0x04 instead of 0x0) so it returns a different address.
Change owner() to return the zero address instead of reading immutable args.
Change owner() to return the contract's own address (address(this)) instead of the immutable arg.
Return the address argument offset one word earlier (use 0x0 instead of 0x14), causing collateral() to read a different embedded address.
Return the address argument offset one word later (use 0x28 instead of 0x14), causing collateral() to read the debt argument instead.
Return a zero address instead of reading immutable args, causing collateral() to always return the zero ERC20 address.
Return the factory address constant by reading the factory arg offset (0x3c) instead of collateral arg, changing collateral() to return the factory address as ERC20.
Replace returned argument offset to read a different immutable arg slot (0x2c instead of 0x28), causing debt() to return a different address read from clone immutables.
Return the owner immutable arg instead of the debt address, making debt() return the owner address cast to ERC20.
Return the factory immutable arg instead of the debt address, making debt() return the factory address cast to ERC20.
Return the zero address (address(0)) cast to ERC20, so debt() always returns the zero address token.
Return the address obtained by shifting the original arg right by 8 bytes (shr 0x50), producing a different address value from the same calldata slot.
